title: The human skeleton’s unique adaptations relied on gene regulatory changes
title_zh: 人类骨骼独特适应性依赖于基因调控变化
abstract: Variants in genes involved in the production of extracellular matrix molecules could have enabled the skeletal adaptations that distinguish humans from other great apes.
abstract_zh: 涉及细胞外基质分子合成的基因变异可能使骨骼适应性得以实现，从而区分人类与其他大型类人猿。
snippet: Variants in genes involved in the production of extracellular matrix molecules could have enabled the skeletal adaptations that distinguish humans from other great apes.
authors_text: Audrey M. Arner, Amanda J. Lea
